title: Pi, whose "security brain" AI agent helps companies assess vulnerabilities to prioritize and patch, raised $35M at a $100M valuation; sources: xAI is a customer (Thomas Brewster/Forbes)
summary: Thomas Brewster / Forbes: Pi, whose “security brain” AI agent helps companies assess vulnerabilities to prioritize and patch, raised $35M at a $100M valuation; sources: xAI is a customer — Startup Pi counts xAI as one of its first customers, sources tell Forbes, as its AI agent looks to fix security vulnerabilities for the world's premier labs.
